budget_priority_boost.method: Start from the top style's budget_split. If the couple names one splurge priority, move 5 points from the lowest-priority category (misc, then stationery) into that category.

styles.name: Romantic Garden
styles.tagline: Blush blooms, soft light, a secret-garden ceremony.
essence: Soft, lush and full of blooms, like a summer garden at golden hour.
Every corner feels gentle, warm and a little bit dreamy.
styles.venue_direction: Botanical garden or estate grounds. Floral arch ceremony, then a tented garden reception under mature trees and string lights.
styles.floral_notes: Garden roses, peonies, sweet pea and trailing greenery in loose, airy shapes. Abundant and soft.
styles.attire_notes: Flowing chiffon or lace gown, floral crown optional. Light suits in sage, tan or soft gray.
styles.signature_moment: A ceremony under a hanging floral arch with petals tossed at the exit.
styles.budget_note: Florals carry this look, so plan a bigger share for flowers. Use a garden venue that is already in bloom to stretch it.

styles.name: Modern Minimal
styles.tagline: Clean lines, quiet luxury, every detail intentional.
essence: Clean lines, open space and a few bold details that say a lot.
Less stuff, more meaning, with room to breathe.
styles.venue_direction: Modern gallery, rooftop or architectural venue. One dramatic installation, negative space everywhere else.
styles.floral_notes: Single-variety arrangements, sculptural branches, calla lilies or orchids in clear glass.
styles.attire_notes: Crepe column dress or sleek jumpsuit. Slim tailored suits in black, navy or stone.
styles.signature_moment: A long single table with candlelight and nothing extra on it.
styles.budget_note: Spend on the space and the food, save on decor. Fewer items, higher quality.

styles.name: Boho Desert
styles.tagline: Golden hour, pampas grass, barefoot and free.
essence: Warm, earthy and free, with texture everywhere you look.
Big skies, red rock and a sunset you will never forget.
styles.venue_direction: Desert overlook or red-rock venue. Sunset ceremony, lounge-style reception under string lights.
styles.floral_notes: Dried pampas, palm spears, bunny tails, protea and terracotta roses in clay vessels.
styles.attire_notes: Flowy lace or crochet-detail dress, bare feet or boots. Linen shirts, suspenders, rolled sleeves.
styles.signature_moment: A lounge of rugs and floor cushions for a sunset toast.
styles.budget_note: Dried florals last and cost less to keep. Rentals like rugs and lounge sets are where the look lives.

styles.name: Classic Black Tie
styles.tagline: Chandeliers, black tie, timeless and grand.
essence: Timeless, formal and polished, with every detail in its place.
A grand night your guests will dress up for.
styles.venue_direction: Grand hotel ballroom or historic mansion. Candlelit ceremony, plated dinner, orchestra or big band.
styles.floral_notes: White roses, hydrangea and orchids in tall, structured centerpieces. White and green, classic.
styles.attire_notes: Ball gown or structured satin with a long veil. Tuxedos and floor-length guest gowns.
styles.signature_moment: A grand entrance followed by a live band first dance.
styles.budget_note: Ballrooms often bundle food and drink, so compare packages. Expect formal service and rentals to add up.

styles.name: Rustic Barn
styles.tagline: Long farm tables, warm wood, everyone welcome.
essence: Cozy, relaxed and welcoming, like a big family dinner in the country.
Wood beams, open fields and good food passed by hand.
styles.venue_direction: Restored barns, farms or ranches with wood beams and open fields. Ceremony in the meadow, dinner in the barn.
styles.floral_notes: Sunflowers, wildflowers, eucalyptus and baby's breath in mason jars and wood boxes.
styles.attire_notes: Lace or boho gown with boots. Vests, suspenders and earthy suits.
styles.signature_moment: Family-style dinner at long farm tables under bistro lights.
styles.budget_note: Barns are often a blank space, so plan for rentals, restrooms and lighting. Family-style food keeps service simple.

styles.name: Coastal Elegance
styles.tagline: Salt air, soft blues, barefoot luxury.
essence: Light, airy and easy, with the sound of water close by.
Polished enough for a gown, relaxed enough for bare feet.
styles.venue_direction: Oceanfront estate, beach club or lakeside lawn. Golden-hour ceremony, breezy open-air dinner.
styles.floral_notes: White orchids, delphinium, sea holly, airy greenery and driftwood accents.
styles.attire_notes: Light chiffon or silk slip dress. Linen or light wool suits, no tie needed.
styles.signature_moment: Barefoot vows at the water's edge as the sun goes down.
styles.budget_note: Waterfront views do the decorating. Budget for wind, tents and a rain plan.

styles.name: Moody Editorial
styles.tagline: Candles, velvet and drama, like a magazine spread.
essence: Dramatic, rich and stylish, like a page from a fashion magazine.
Deep color, low light and photos that look like art.
styles.venue_direction: Historic libraries, dark-walled restaurants or an urban space with dramatic lighting.
styles.floral_notes: Deep burgundy dahlias, black calla lilies, plum ranunculus and taper candles.
styles.attire_notes: Velvet, satin or a bold cape. Dark suits in black, oxblood or forest green.
styles.signature_moment: A candle-lit reception with a dramatic night portrait session.
styles.budget_note: Candles and lighting matter more than volume of flowers. Put more into photo and video.

styles.name: Whimsical Vintage
styles.tagline: Teacups, old songs and a little bit of magic.
essence: Playful, nostalgic and personal, with treasures from another era.
It feels like a story only the two of you could tell.
styles.venue_direction: Historic homes, tea gardens or a quirky old theater full of charm.
styles.floral_notes: Ranunculus, sweet pea, cosmos and fern in mismatched vintage vessels.
styles.attire_notes: Tea-length dress, birdcage veil, pearls. Suspenders, bow ties and tweed.
styles.signature_moment: A dessert table of family recipes and a vintage car getaway.
styles.budget_note: Thrifted and borrowed pieces keep costs down. Spend on a few personal touches guests will remember.

styles.name: Mountain Lodge
styles.tagline: Pine air, warm wood, candlelight under the peaks.
essence: Big views, fresh air and a warm lodge waiting after the vows.
Rugged outside, cozy and golden inside.
styles.venue_direction: Mountain lodge, ranch or aspen grove. Ceremony with a peak backdrop, reception in a timber pavilion.
styles.floral_notes: Wild greens, white blooms, pine, thistle and lanterns with wood accents.
styles.attire_notes: Long sleeves or a wrap for cool nights. Wool, tweed or earth-tone suits, boots welcome.
styles.signature_moment: Vows at the overlook, then s'mores by a big stone fireplace.
styles.budget_note: Travel and lodging matter here, so pick a site with rooms on site. Shuttle costs can add up.

styles.name: Hacienda Fiesta
styles.tagline: Warm color, live music, a table that never empties.
essence: Bright color, big family and music that pulls everyone onto the floor.
A courtyard party that honors where you come from.
styles.venue_direction: Hacienda courtyard or Spanish-style villa. Papel picado overhead, long family tables, mariachi or a live band.
styles.floral_notes: Marigolds, bougainvillea, dahlias and bold color everywhere.
styles.attire_notes: Embroidered or off-shoulder gown, mantilla veil. Guayaberas or light suits in cream and tan.
styles.signature_moment: The lazo ceremony, then a mariachi entrance into the courtyard.
styles.budget_note: Big guest lists drive cost, so food and music get the biggest share. Local vendors stretch it further.

styles.name: Vineyard Classic
styles.tagline: Rows of vines, long tables, wine at golden hour.
essence: Relaxed elegance among the vines, with food and wine at the center.
Slow dinners, warm light and toasts that run long.
styles.venue_direction: Winery estate. Ceremony between the rows, reception in a barrel room or on the terrace.
styles.floral_notes: Burgundy dahlias, eucalyptus runners, figs, grapes and candlelight.
styles.attire_notes: Soft satin or crepe gown. Light suits in tan, olive or navy.
styles.signature_moment: A long harvest table between the vines with a sunset wine toast.
styles.budget_note: Many wineries have wine minimums or set caterers, so check the rules. Harvest season books fast.

styles.name: Tropical Island
styles.tagline: Palms, warm water and color that pops.
essence: Sun, sea and bright flowers on an island far from home.
Easy days, warm nights and a party under the palms.
styles.venue_direction: Beach resort or garden estate on an island. Ceremony on the sand or a cliff, dinner under the palms.
styles.floral_notes: Orchids, anthurium, plumeria, bird of paradise and monstera leaves.
styles.attire_notes: Light silk or chiffon, flower in the hair. Linen suits, open collars, sandals.
styles.signature_moment: A lei exchange at sunset, then fire dancers on the beach.
styles.budget_note: Resort packages often bundle food, rooms and setup. Guest travel is a big part of the plan.

styles.name: Italian Villa
styles.tagline: Lemon trees, sea views and la dolce vita.
essence: Sun-washed walls, long lunches and a view of the sea.
Simple, rich and full of joy, the Italian way.
styles.venue_direction: Hilltop villa, cliffside terrace or Tuscan estate. Ceremony in the garden, dinner on the terrace.
styles.floral_notes: Lemon branches, olive, white garden roses, jasmine and herbs.
styles.attire_notes: Silk or linen gown, simple veil. Light tailored suits in cream, sky blue or tan.
styles.signature_moment: A long al fresco dinner with lemon trees and a sea view at sunset.
styles.budget_note: Travel and local rules shape the plan. Many villas include rooms for a weekend stay.

styles.name: French Chateau
styles.tagline: Castle walls, soft gilt and storybook romance.
essence: Refined and romantic, like stepping into a fairy tale.
Gilded mirrors, stone halls and gardens made for strolling.
styles.venue_direction: Chateau, castle or manor with formal gardens. Ceremony on the lawn, dinner in a grand salon.
styles.floral_notes: Garden roses, hydrangea, lavender and lilac in gold urns.
styles.attire_notes: Lace or tulle gown with a long train. Morning suits or classic tuxedos.
styles.signature_moment: A grand staircase entrance and a champagne tower in the salon.
styles.budget_note: Many chateaux rent for a full weekend with rooms. Florals and rentals lean formal.

styles.name: Industrial Loft
styles.tagline: Brick, steel and city lights.
essence: Raw brick, steel beams and a big open floor for the party.
City cool with warm, glowing light.
styles.venue_direction: Converted warehouse, brewery or loft. Ceremony under the beams, dinner and dancing on the same floor.
styles.floral_notes: Greenery walls, air plants, bare branches and potted herbs in copper.
styles.attire_notes: Sleek modern gown or jumpsuit. Sharp suits, sneakers welcome on the dance floor.
styles.signature_moment: A first dance under a canopy of Edison bulbs.
styles.budget_note: Raw spaces need rentals, lighting and sometimes catering brought in. Weekday dates help.

styles.name: Heritage Asian
styles.tagline: Hanok courtyards, ryokan gardens and old traditions.
essence: Calm, graceful and rooted in tradition, from hanok courtyards to temple gardens.
Every detail has meaning, and family is at the heart.
styles.venue_direction: Hanok house, ryokan, temple garden or heritage hall. Traditional ceremony, then a modern dinner.
styles.floral_notes: Cherry blossom, peony, orchid, pine and simple ikebana-style shapes.
styles.attire_notes: Hanbok, kimono or another heritage outfit for the ceremony, then a gown and suit for the party.
styles.signature_moment: A traditional ceremony in a courtyard with family bowing together.
styles.budget_note: Cultural attire and ceremony guides may need booking early. Small courtyards keep guest counts low.

styles.name: Glasshouse Conservatory
styles.tagline: Glass walls, green leaves and all-day light.
essence: A glass house full of plants and soft natural light.
Garden feeling, any weather.
styles.venue_direction: Conservatory, greenhouse or botanical glass house. Ceremony among the plants, dinner under the glass roof.
styles.floral_notes: Ferns, hanging greenery, orchids and potted citrus mixed with soft garden blooms.
styles.attire_notes: Light airy gown, floral details. Suits in sage, cream or soft gray.
styles.signature_moment: Vows in the glass house as the light changes overhead.
styles.budget_note: The plants are already there, so florals can be lighter. Glass rooms can get warm, plan for air flow.

styles.name: Winter Wonderland
styles.tagline: Snow, candlelight and a little sparkle.
essence: Crisp air, soft snow and a warm glow inside.
Velvet, candles and a magical winter night.
styles.venue_direction: Snowy lodge, historic hotel or chapel with fireplaces. Ceremony by candlelight, reception by the fire.
styles.floral_notes: White amaryllis, winter berries, frosted branches, pine and silver dollar eucalyptus.
styles.attire_notes: Long sleeves, a faux fur wrap or cape. Velvet jackets and wool suits.
styles.signature_moment: A snowy portrait walk, then hot cocoa and sparklers.
styles.budget_note: Winter dates are often cheaper to book. Plan for heat, coat check and travel delays.

styles.name: Art Deco Glam
styles.tagline: Gold, mirrors and a 1920s party.
essence: Bold shapes, gold shine and a roaring party all night.
Glamorous and fun, like stepping into the Jazz Age.
styles.venue_direction: 1920s hotel, theater or ballroom with gold and mirrors. Cocktail hour in the lobby, dancing all night.
styles.floral_notes: White calla lilies, feathers, orchids and gold-sprayed leaves in tall vases.
styles.attire_notes: Beaded or fringe gown, headpiece and long gloves. Tuxedos with bow ties.
styles.signature_moment: A champagne tower and a big band jazz set.
styles.budget_note: Music and bar carry the night. Historic hotels often include decor that already shines.

styles.name: English Countryside
styles.tagline: Cottage gardens, manor lawns and afternoon tea.
essence: Gentle hills, stone walls and a manor house garden.
Classic and calm, with a touch of storybook charm.
styles.venue_direction: Country manor, stately home or village church with a garden marquee. Lawn games and tea on the terrace.
styles.floral_notes: Foxglove, delphinium, garden roses, sweet pea and cottage wildflowers.
styles.attire_notes: Classic lace or soft crepe gown. Morning suits, tweed or light gray suits.
styles.signature_moment: Afternoon tea and lawn games on the manor grounds.
styles.budget_note: Marquees and rentals add cost on lawns. Many manors include rooms for the wedding party.
